description: Search Redfin for real estate listings — for sale, recently sold, or rental properties.

includeDetails.description: Fetch each listing's below-the-fold detail payload: price history, tax history, public records (APN, county, year renovated), and amenities. Adds one request per emitted listing.
includeDetails.title: Include detail enrichment

keyword.description: Case-insensitive keyword matched against address, description, listing tags, key facts, subdivision, and building name. Required in `search` mode and optional in other modes.
keyword.title: Keyword

listingUrl.description: Full Redfin listing URL containing `/home/<id>`, e.g. `https://www.redfin.com/TX/Austin/123-Main-St-78701/home/12345678`.
listingUrl.title: Listing URL (mode=byUrl)

location.description: City and state (`Austin, TX`), ZIP (`90210`, `10001`, `78701`), neighborhood (`South Congress, Austin, TX`), Redfin search URL, or a region token such as `6_30818` (city region 30818).
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (1-20,000). This is a self-imposed cap; Redfin returned homes at a start offset of 19,950 in verification. Deep offsets in very large regions can return an empty page.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Maximum sale price, or maximum monthly rent in forRent mode.
maxPrice.title: Max price ($)

minPrice.description: Minimum sale price, or minimum monthly rent in forRent mode.
minPrice.title: Min price ($)

mode.description: What type of listings to fetch.
enumTitles: Recently Sold — sold within the chosen window
Search — keyword filter within a location
By URL — fetch a single Redfin listing URL
mode.title: Mode

propertyType.description: Filter by property type. Applied server-side where Redfin supports it and re-checked in the actor.
propertyType.sectionDescription: Optional price, bedroom, bathroom, size, and sold-window filters.
propertyType.title: Property type

soldWithinDays.description: How far back to search in recentlySold mode. Ignored in other modes.
soldWithinDays.title: Sold within (days)

sort.description: Result ordering. Verified against Redfin's GIS and rental APIs.
sort.title: Sort order

title: Redfin Scraper Input
